# viettelcloud_volume_snapshot_policy (Data Source)

Get one Viettel Cloud volume snapshot policy by ID or exact filter criteria. The policy must use a weekly schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_volume_snapshot_policy" "nightly" {
  name   = "example-nightly"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Snapshot policy ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Snapshot policy name to filter by.
- `region` (String) Project region name to filter by.
- `status` (String) Policy status to filter by: enabled or disabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Snapshot policy description.
- `last_execution` (String) Time of the latest policy run (RFC3339). Null before the first run.
- `retention` (Number) Number of snapshots that the policy keeps for each volume.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Weekly schedule on which the policy takes snapshots. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `state` (String) State of the latest policy run.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC3339).
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of volumes that use the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `days_of_week` (Set of String) Days of the week on which the policy takes a snapshot.
- `time` (String) Time of day in UTC at which the policy takes a snapshot.
